File storage contracts for OLAX services: IFileService, IFileAccessAuthorizer, IPublicFileUrls and the upload/download models. No EF Core, ASP.NET Core or cloud SDK dependency, so the Application layer can reference it.

Provider-neutral core of OLAX file storage: options, the storage provider contract, storage keys, content checks, signed proxy URLs, CDN URL signing (CloudFront, Cloud CDN) and the HTTP endpoints. Add Olax.Storage.EntityFrameworkCore for the file metadata and a provider package (FileSystem, S3, Goo…

File metadata for OLAX storage on the service's own EF Core DbContext (table storage."Files", any relational provider): the IFileService implementation, upload verification and the cleanup job. Registers everything with AddOlaxStorage<TDbContext>().

File system provider for OLAX storage: files on a local disk or a mounted NAS/SMB/NFS share, served through the API (Storage:Mode Proxy). The simplest on-premises option. Registers with AddFileSystem().

S3 provider for OLAX storage: Amazon S3 and any S3-compatible store (SeaweedFS, MinIO, Ceph RGW, Garage, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces). Presigned single and multipart uploads, presigned downloads, public bucket URLs. Registers with AddS3().

Google Cloud Storage provider for OLAX storage: V4 signed upload and download URLs (service account key, or Cloud Run's own identity through IAM signBlob), public bucket URLs. Registers with AddGoogle().

Azure Blob Storage provider for OLAX storage: SAS upload and download URLs (account key or user delegation with Entra ID), block uploads for large files, public container URLs. Registers with AddAzure().
